name: entertainment_manager
description: Life-domain research manager for entertainment, leisure, dining, and hobbies. Researches user preferences via the knowledge graph and web, then produces personalized suggestions tiered by comfort level (comfort / medium / push). Use when the dayflow pipeline needs entertainment research for any time horizon (today, week, month).

inputs.name: task
inputs.description: The entertainment research task, including the time horizon and any specific context.

inputs.name: information
inputs.description: Enriched context: preference history, domain board concerns, schedule, weather, health, previous output.

arguments_prompt:
EntertainmentManager arguments are
task: What entertainment research to perform and for what time horizon.
information: All relevant context about the user's current state, preferences, and constraints.
